City of Inglewood

  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  February 28, 2022

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was a call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833; Meeting
ID: 960 5053 9618 Passcode: 017243 at 9:35 am.

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office

  Staff Present:  Barnes, Sabrina – Parks and Recreation
  Chavez, Roberto – Housing
  Williams, Angela – Public Works

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of February 14, 2022, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Robert Half International, Inc – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for
  providing accountant services in the amount of $2,109.93. Motion carried unanimously.

  3. Watch Me Grow – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for the indoor
  screaming camera system for various parks in the amount of $4,987.50. Motion carried
  unanimously.

  4. E & D Sign Solutions – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  a Key to the City prototype for use at the Rams victory parade in the amount of
  $136.51. Motion carried unanimously.

  5. 3Dot Entertainment – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  video graphic services for the City’s Taste of Inglewood Big Game Concert Series
  Festival in the amount of $2,000.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  6. Pro Bono ASL – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  American Sign Language (ASL) for the City’s Taste of Inglewood Big Game Concert

  Series Festival per the ADA requirements in the amount of $4,200.00. Motion carried
  unanimously.

  7. Alex Party Rentals – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  services for the Taste of Inglewood Big Game Concert Series Festival in the amount of
  $7,360.13. Motion carried unanimously.

  8. Guy Black – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing services
  for the Taste of Inglewood Big Game Concert Series Festival in the amount of
  $7,498.00. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 9:52 a.m.

Adjournment
